Subject: Draft MAP: Security review + SOC 2 package (next steps)

Hi Daniel & Tim —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, I’m attaching a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security milestone so your security and procurement teams have clear deliverables and target dates. Key items I captured:

- Security review kickoff: confirm point-of-contact and preferred evidence transfer method (SFTP/Drive) — target: 2026-03-05
- SOC 2 package delivery: initial artifact bundle (summary + checklist + answers) — target: 2026-03-10
- Follow-up Q&A session with our security lead (Naomi) — target: week of 2026-03-15
- Procurement & contract redlines due: 2026-03-22
- Target commercial close: 2026-04-15 (depends on successful security review)

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf] [Attachment: soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx] [Attachment: redwood-saa-soc2-answers.docx]

Next steps for Acme: please confirm the security POC (who will own evidence collection) and whether you prefer documents via a shared Drive link or SFTP. If you’d like, I can provision a secure Drive folder and send an invite to the POC.

I’ve looped in Rishi for procurement cadence and Naomi for technical evidence / SOC 2 clarifications.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security review + SOC 2 package (next steps)

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. Quick notes from our side:

1) Security POC: Daniel Park (security@acme-corp.com) — I will own evidence collection, with Tim as the technical reviewer.
2) Preferred transfer: please provision a secure Drive folder (we can accept a limited-access link).
3) Evidence expectations: the checklist looks good; please add a column that indicates whether each evidence artifact is redacted or original (we often need to know).

We can commit to a kickoff by 2026-03-05; SOC 2 artifact delivery by 2026-03-10 is tight but feasible if Redwood can supply the answers doc and the summary today (so we can map gaps).

Also, can Naomi confirm how long it typically takes to turn around CSV export requests or access logs if we ask during the review?

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Retail
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security review + SOC 2 package (next steps)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks — quick answers below to help you plan: 

- CSV export / access logs: we typically produce a scoped export within 2 business days for documented requests; full log runs may take 3-5 business days depending on retention windows.
- Redaction guidance: we can supply both redacted artifacts and a redaction manifest showing what was removed. I’ll add a column in the checklist for redaction status and ship an updated checklist by EOD 2026-03-02.
- Drive provisioning: Marissa, if you create the folder and invite security@acme-corp.com and tim.thomas@acme-corp.com, we’ll upload the current artifacts there.

Naomi Feldman
Security Lead, Redwood Inference

I uploaded the initial artifacts: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Naomi will update with redaction column), and redwood-saa-soc2-answers.docx. You should have view access; let me know if you need edit access.

- 2026-03-05: Security kickoff (Owner: Daniel) — confirm evidence list and delivery cadence
- 2026-03-10: Initial SOC 2 artifact drop (Owner: Redwood/Naomi) — upload to shared Drive
- 2026-03-15: Technical Q&A session (Owner: Naomi / Tim) — 45-min call to walk artifacts
- 2026-03-22: Procurement contract redlines (Owner: Asha / Rishi)
- 2026-04-15: Target commercial close (Owner: Marissa / Acme procurement)

Can everyone please confirm owners and the 2026-03-10 artifact drop commitment? If that slips, we should agree a revised target to avoid pushing the close date.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa —

Confirmed: Asha here from procurement. Owners look fine. A few procurement asks: 

- Please send a short summary of hosting/data residency (where customer data is stored) for our legal team to review.
- We need to see proof of incident response policy and SOC 2 Type II report (summary is fine for now) — if you can flag which files in the Drive correspond to those items, that would be very helpful.
- Preferred next step: we’ll aim to complete contract redlines by 2026-03-22 but may need a brief extension if the SOC 2 artifacts reveal gaps.

Daniel, Tim — can you confirm whether the Drive link Marissa sent includes the incident response and SOC 2 summary? Marissa / Naomi, if not present, can you drop those by 2026-03-06 EOD?
